topography.project_purpose: NFT Marketplace. Structurally: 66 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 9 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc721burnable, erc165, lssvmpairenumerable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
